_doc: Who is where in Vellmar (design/open-world/world.md §3). schedule: a spot (data/world/map.json spots) for each time of day, or "" for off the map. overrides: the first that holds wins: days ("4", "1-7", "2,3"), times (comma list or any), when (a story condition), spot, and seek: walk up to the wizard and start talking (once a loop). from_day: not in town before that day. barks: lines said over the head now and then, the first few that hold are picked at random; each can have days, times and when. figure: the look in data/visual.json figures. reach: how close you must be to talk (sim px).

barks.text: Where did I put the Hours index...
Mind the third shelf. It bites.
The stars are wrong tonight. Everyone says so.
There you are.
Lamp oil's gone up again.
One more, then the next.
Go home, College. It's not safe after dark.
Watch and learn.
Hm. The one from the stairs.
...Again.
Flour and ash. Flour and ash.
College! Please, a word!
It's this afternoon. It's always the afternoon.
A drink for the robe! Two!
I'm not scared of the dark. I'm scared of what's in it.
Can you hear that? Someone's out there.
Gate's open. Mind the stairs.
Curfew, apprentice.
Trial's open. If you've the nerve.
Candles, charms, good luck for the Eclipse.
Never greet your own shadow.
Pies! Hot pies!
That dog in the square's gone mad, I swear it.
Wuff.
(whines at the corner)

_crowd_doc: Townsfolk who wander the market and the square by day: how many at each time of day, and where they wander.

barks: Did you hear about the fire on the College stairs?
Hollows past the walls again last night.
The Orrery's humming. Can you hear it?
My cousin swears the dead walk at the Mill.
They say the Provost hasn't been seen since the light.

_reactions_doc: How people answer magic cast near them (OW2, interactions.md §5): within flinch_r sim px of a spell they step back flinch_step and say a flinch line (a person's own "flinch" list if they have one), then not again for flinch_cool seconds. Fire in the College brings the porter's line if the porter can see you (bark_range), at most every scold_cool seconds. Lighting a lamp on Mira's lane before she does brings mira_thanks if she's near, and a thank-you scene when you next talk to her.

reactions.porter_fire: Not in the College! Fire on the stairs is how all this started.
reactions.mira_thanks: My lane's lit? That was you, College. Thank you.
